approved_direction: Preserve charcoal/black foundation, warm copper-orange accents, refined typography, Cincinnati imagery, generous public spacing and dense internal operational views. Do not convert to generic SaaS styling.
constraints: Residential and commercial fields are separate.
All inventory and role information is explicitly synthetic; no invented verified claims, biographies or testimonials.
Every image overlay requires a contrast-preserving scrim; carousel must have pause and reduced-motion support.
No live authentication, MFA, money movement, screening, messaging, document uploads or lease execution.
Role previews must open actual shells; future actions are disabled.
Interactive and critical information elements have unique data-testid attributes.
Hiding demonstration labels also removes seeded surfaces through explicit feature flags.
source_of_truth: docs/phase0/README.md and backend/foundation/ supersede all earlier illustrative operating policies and role examples.
